title: Hybrid game-hop chain bounds CCA advantage by the MAC and CPA epsilons
intent: Prove the CCA-security bound of the MAC-then-CPA construction (CCA_EVAL) as a chain of game hops: one ssprove triangle turns Advantage CCA_EVAL A into a sum over six intermediate packages, and four named program-equivalence lemmas, one per hop, collapse that chain to mac_epsilon (A ∘ CCA_EVAL_TAG_pkg_tt) + cpa_epsilon (A ∘ CCA_EVAL_HYB_pkg) + mac_epsilon (A ∘ CCA_EVAL_TAG_pkg_ff).

parent.name: security_based_on_mac
parent.statement:
Theorem security_based_on_mac LA A:
  ValidPackage LA
    [interface
      #val #[eavesdrop]: 'word × 'word → 'word × 'word ;
      #val #[decrypt]: 'word × 'word → 'option 'word ]
    A_export A ->
  fseparate LA TAG_locs_tt ->
  fseparate LA TAG_locs_ff ->
  fseparate LA CPA_EVAL_locs ->
  fseparate LA CCA_EVAL_locs ->
  fseparate LA CCA_EVAL_TAG_locs ->
  fseparate LA CCA_EVAL_HYB_locs ->
  Advantage CCA_EVAL A <=
  mac_epsilon (A ∘ CCA_EVAL_TAG_pkg_tt) +
  cpa_epsilon (A ∘ CCA_EVAL_HYB_pkg) +
  mac_epsilon (A ∘ CCA_EVAL_TAG_pkg_ff).

applicability.goal_shape: A goal Advantage P A <= mac_epsilon (A ∘ Q1) + cpa_epsilon (A ∘ Q2) + ... bounding a composed package's advantage by a sum of named sub-advantages, where the packages on both sides are linked by perfect-indistinguishability (≈₀) hops.
applicability.use_when: the bound is a hybrid argument: an ssprove triangle (or the equivalent triangle inequality) lists a chain of intermediate packages whose adjacent pairs are equivalent by reflexivity after unfolding or by a small memory invariant, and the boundary terms are definitionally the sub-advantages (mac_epsilon/cpa_epsilon).
applicability.avoid_when: a hop needs a non-trivial reduction or an event-based (bad-event) bound rather than an exact ≈₀ equivalence; the intermediate packages are not definitionally equal to the advantage terms, so the closing rewrite /mac_epsilon /cpa_epsilon will not fire; or a hop is not between adjacent terms of the chain, so the triangle list and the rewrite lemmas do not line up.

consequences: Turns one CCA-security bound into a six-package hybrid triangle plus four program-equivalence lemmas, one per hop, so each hole is one bounded program-equivalence proof. Obligations: each hop lemma must be an exact ≈₀ equivalence between the adjacent packages named by the triangle; the triangle's package list, the four rewrites and the mac_epsilon/cpa_epsilon definitions must all agree exactly, or a rewrite fails; the two reflexive hops depend on both ssprove_code_simpl passes unfolding the two sides to the same program. Failure modes: a hop lemma stated over the wrong b flag or composition order leaves a residual term no later rewrite removes; the two hybrid hops each carry their own invariant (couple_lhs/couple_rhs on S_loc/T_loc), and getting the invariant or its side wrong breaks the r_get/r_put bookkeeping.
